prediction.statement: Each conscious experience goes with its own pattern of synchrony between category-selective areas and early visual areas, inside posterior cortex.

first_stated.passage: Here, each distinct conscious experience should lead to distinct patterns of synchronization between areas in posterior cortex i.e., category selective areas and early sensory areas.

source.citation: Melloni L, Mudrik L, Pitts M, et al. Preregistration file v1, January 2019: Accelerating research on consciousness: an adversarial collaboration to test contradictory predictions of global neuronal workspace and integrated information theory. OSF project mbcfy, component wz8mj

prediction.test_against: No sustained content-specific synchrony between category-selective areas and V1/V2, by the measure agreed in advance.
